The bug was twofold: the CRC-update loop only iterated 7 times instead of 8, and `valid` was checked before `clear`, violating the spec's requirement that `clear` take priority. Both are fixed in `rtl/crc8.v:17` and `rtl/crc8.v:28-30`.

The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).
